title: Next-day management admission of previously realized groundwater transfer

sequencing.rationale: Freeze the next-boundary handoff before observing DUMMY-20E2 active-transfer runtime output.

ribasim_release_semantics: fixed allocation.dt=24 h causes allocation solves at t=0 and t=24 h
Basin allocation data uses current storage at the allocation boundary
Basin vertical_flux.drainage is included as explicit positive forcing over the allocation horizon
FlowBoundary source is included in allocation availability
source_binding.implication: At t=24 h the allocator can use retained Basin storage plus the still-active groundwater drainage forcing for the day-2 decision.

allocation_at_24h.rationale: 21.9754186088 m3 retained storage above the 1.0 m hold level + 32 m3/day source + 8 m3/day drainage forcing provides more than the 60 m3/day total demand over the allocation horizon.

independent_day2_reference.equation: A dh/dtau = 40 - 60*phi(h-0.99), tau in days after t=24 h
independent_day2_reference.final_ledger: 64 m3 fixed source + 14 m3 groundwater transfer = 46.14571463 m3 cumulative UserDemand supply + 31.85428537 m3 Basin storage gain

hypotheses: DUMMY-20E2 day-1 behavior remains the first-day prefix: external demand is not supplied before the t=24 h allocation boundary.
At t=24 h the fixed allocation.dt boundary admits the accepted physical memory accumulated during day 1.
The active 8 m3/day groundwater drainage is included in the day-2 allocation forcing.
The t=24 h management decision fully allocates root=40 and external=20 m3/day.
External cumulative physical supply becomes positive only after t=24 h.
Day-2 root and external physical supplies follow a 2:1 split because both recipients share the same physical min_level reduction factor.
The accepted-state trajectory and reciprocal ledger follow the frozen two-day continuous reference.
forbidden: no change to allocation.dt, saveat or product timestep
no change to groundwater activation boundary or magnitude
no post-output tuning of day-2 references
